source_text: 36 QUI IUDAEI DIANT FANATIC. ? Quid? medius Iudaeus, medius uis esse profanus? Unde non effugies iudicium Christi defunctus. Ipse caecus erras et ad caecos intras, inepte; Idcirco caecus caecum in fossa reducit. Uadis ubi nescis, et inscius inde recedis. Discentes ad doctos eunt, ut docti recedant, At tu aliis uadis, unde nihil discere possis. Exis pro foribus, inde et ad idola uadis. Interroga primum, quod sit in lege praeceptum, Dicant illi tibi, si iussum est deos adorare. Ignoratur enim propter quod maxime sumus: At illi quoniam rei sunt ex ipso delicto, Nihil de praeceptis Dei nisi mirabilia narrant. Tunc tamen in fossam secum uos caeci deducunt. Funera sunt; nimium de illis tota deferre, Aut, quia concludor, agerem congustus aratris. Noluit Omnipotens illos intellegere Regem; A scelere a tanto refugit ipse cruentos. Tradidit se nobis <noua> superaddita lege, Inde modo latrant nobiscum re<ge> deserti. Ceterum in illis si spem <in>esse putatis, ********
pass_a_gloss: Medius Iudaeus / medius… profanus → non effugies iudicium Christi defunctus. Blind guides into fossa; idols after doors. Omnipotens refused they know Regem; He gave Himself by nova lex. Hope in them is lacuna-cut error.
pass_b_english: What? Half a Jew, you want to be half profane? From there you will not escape Christ’s judgment when dead. Yourself blind you wander and foolishly go in among the blind; therefore a blind man leads a blind man into the ditch. You go where you do not know, and unaware you leave from there. Learners go to the learned so they may leave learned, but you go to others from whom you can learn nothing. You go out before the doors, and thence also you go to the idols. Ask first what is commanded in the law; let them tell you if it is ordered to adore the gods. For it is ignored because of that for which we chiefly exist; but since they are guilty from the crime itself, they tell nothing of God’s precepts except marvels. Then still, blind, they lead you with them into the ditch. There are funerals; too much to report of them all — or, because I am shut in, I would work cramped among ploughs. The Almighty refused that they understand the King; from so great a crime He Himself fled those bloody men. He handed Himself to us by a superadded new law; thence now they bark with us, deserted by the King. But if you think there is hope in them — ******

choices.choose: you will not escape Christ’s judgment
choices.why: Unde non effugies iudicium Christi defunctus.

choices.choose: leave double course of blind guides
